_about: The public roadmap in Truebex's own words. Titles and descriptions are written by hand (brand voice); `status` is written by scripts/sync-roadmap.mjs from the app and platform trackers. Nothing here moves into FEATURES automatically.

items.title: Works with IFC and DWG
items.description: Exchange models and drawings with every other tool on the project.

items.title: Projects from other tools
items.description: Bring in reference scenes and whole projects from the tools your partners use, without a plugin.

items.title: Point clouds, checks and handover
items.description: Point clouds, coordination issues, model checks against requirements, and building data handed over in open formats.

items.title: Roofs, curtain walls and structure
items.description: Roofs with skylights, glazing systems, columns, beams, foundations, railings, ramps and lifts.

items.title: Site, wall layers and materials
items.description: Topography, layered wall assemblies and a material library with physical properties.

items.title: Clash detection
items.description: Find where elements collide before anyone on site does.

items.title: Building services
items.description: Ducts, pipes and circuits that route and size themselves.

items.title: Elevations, revisions and print sets
items.description: Elevations, legends, keynotes, detail views, revisions, view templates, phases and design options.

items.title: Schedules of everything
items.description: Quantities, bills of quantities and material take-off that update as you draw.

items.title: Daylight, energy, sound and wind reports
items.description: Measured results from the one true model, on demand or as you work.

items.title: Panoramas, tours and share links
items.description: Panoramas, 360° tours, videos and sun studies, shared with a link that opens on any phone.

items.title: Step inside with a headset
items.description: Walk the model in a PC headset, and see cloud panoramas on a standalone one.

items.title: Room themes
items.description: A whole look for a room, applied in one step.

items.title: Your team on one model
items.description: Several people in one project, with every change in a history you can rewind.

items.title: On your phone and in a headset
items.description: Panoramas rendered in the cloud, refreshed the moment anything changes, and edits from wherever you are.

items.title: The model prices itself
items.description: Real products with live prices and stock, by region, so the bill of quantities updates as you draw.

items.title: An assistant that edits the model
items.description: Ask for a window on the north wall and it appears, with the light measured and the change undoable.

items.title: Checks and layouts made for you
items.description: Code checks, furniture layouts by room type, and presentation packs prepared automatically.

items.title: Scripts for repeat work
items.description: A script console over the same actions as the assistant, with scripts saved as assets.

items.title: Arabic, right to left
items.description: The whole app in Arabic, with metric and imperial units.

items.title: Sign in, trial and updates
items.description: Sign in from the app, try Pro free for 14 days, and get updates on a stable or beta channel.

items.title: A public API, webhooks and SDKs
items.description: Work with your projects from your own code, with webhooks and ready-made SDKs.

items.title: Feedback and reliability
items.description: Opt-in crash reports, in-app feedback with a screenshot, and a platform that stays up.
